title: Identity Protocol
tagline: Arrest or kill. The machine decides.
intro: You are an experimental police robot being trained to replace the human force. Each mission is a situation with more than one way through it. How you handle it decides whether the experiment survives.

pillars.title: Brute Force
pillars.text: Go in loud. Fast, direct, and the people inside remember it.

pillars.title: Tactical
pillars.text: Plan the entry, control the room, keep everyone breathing.

pillars.title: Negotiation
pillars.text: Talk them out. Slower, riskier, and nobody has to get hurt.

squad_text: A hive mind of up to four robot units under your control. Where you send them, and what you let them do, is on you.
